Package com.github.query4j.core.config

Class CacheConfig

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.core.config.CacheConfig
public final class CacheConfig extends Object
Immutable configuration properties for Query4j cache module. Provides control over caching behavior, TTL settings, and performance parameters.

This configuration is used by cache managers to initialize and configure cache instances. All values are validated and provide safe defaults for production use.

Since:
1.0.0

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled()
      Enable or disable caching globally. When disabled, all cache operations become no-ops.

    • getDefaultTtlSeconds

      public long getDefaultTtlSeconds()
      Default cache TTL (time-to-live) in seconds. Cached entries will be evicted after this time.

    • getMaxSize

      public long getMaxSize()
      Maximum cache size (number of entries). When exceeded, LRU eviction policy applies.

    • getDefaultRegion

      public String getDefaultRegion()
      Default cache region name for unnamed cache instances.

    • isStatisticsEnabled

      public boolean isStatisticsEnabled()
      Enable detailed cache statistics collection. When disabled, improves performance but reduces observability.

    • getMaintenanceIntervalSeconds

      public long getMaintenanceIntervalSeconds()
      Cache maintenance interval in seconds. How often to run cleanup operations for expired entries.

    • isKeyValidationEnabled

      public boolean isKeyValidationEnabled()
      Enable cache key validation. When enabled, validates cache keys match expected patterns.

    • getMaxKeyLength

      public int getMaxKeyLength()
      Maximum cache key length in characters. Prevents memory issues with excessively long keys.

    • getConcurrencyLevel

      public int getConcurrencyLevel()
      Cache concurrency level for internal data structures. Higher values improve concurrent access performance.

    • isAutoWarmupEnabled

      public boolean isAutoWarmupEnabled()
      Enable automatic cache warming on startup. When enabled, cache will be pre-populated with common queries.

    • getWarmupSize

      public int getWarmupSize()
      Number of entries to pre-load during cache warming.
